Community Guidelines

The Spirit of Talery

Be Respectful

Treat fellow travelers with kindness, curiosity, and respect for different cultures and perspectives.

Stay Safe

Protect your privacy, verify information, and report behavior that makes the community unsafe.

Travel Mindfully

Support local communities, minimize environmental impact, and leave places better than you found them.

Share Authentically

Post genuine experiences, give honest recommendations, and credit creators and locals appropriately.
